title: Capability Request
description: Context raised with intent `GetCapabilities`. The `capability` enum selects which catalog slice to return as the IntentResult.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: Ask for the slim app catalog. IntentResult is `fdc3.capability.appDirectory`.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: Ask for the intent catalog. IntentResult is `fdc3.capability.intentList`.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: Ask for the context-type catalog. IntentResult is `fdc3.capability.contextTypeList`.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: Ask for the JSON Schema for one context type. IntentResult is `fdc3.capability.contextSchema`.

contextType.title: Context type
contextType.description: FDC3 context `type` string whose JSON Schema should be returned, e.g. `fdc3.instrument` or `fdc3.data.markdown`.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: Ask for the full App Directory record for one appId. IntentResult is `fdc3.capability.appDirectoryRecord`.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: FDC3 App Directory `appId` whose full record should be returned.
